dataEffects: Affected orders spend their charge budget, then their reconciliation budget, and park in payment_unknown with their stock still reserved.
Parked orders are rechecked after PAYMENT_UNKNOWN_RECHECK_MS; with the provider back, they are voided and fail, releasing their stock.
description: The payment provider is unavailable for both charges and lookups, so orders exhaust their charge budget, fail reconciliation, and park in payment_unknown with their stock held.
expectedRemediation: Let the parked orders be rechecked, or recheck them sooner, and confirm none stay in payment_unknown.

primarySymptom.description: Reconciliation lookups against the payment provider fail.

rootCause.summary: The payment provider rejects every charge and lookup as unavailable.
